Amends existing statutes regarding forest management, electric rights-of-way, timber sales, categorical exclusions, and intervendor status, while creating new reporting and pilot programs.
dimensions.evidence: This bill establishes forest management requirements for federal lands, particularly with respect to reducing wildfires.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes new management requirements, tracking procedures, reporting mandates, and pilot programs across federal forest lands, affecting federal land management agencies, local governments, and commercial operators.
